name: Haiti

validation.referee: statute's own printed figures and hand-computed statutory cases (#guard)

headline: F1 The tax authority publishes only the 2026 Code: the law that governed 2025 is not on its site

scale.source: Code Fiscal (Le Moniteur Special 48-A, 30 Sep 2026) art. 132 d.: 'de 1 080 001 Gourdes a 2 160 000 Gourdes: 25%' (start of the 25 % band)
scale.basis: Code Fiscal (Le Moniteur Special 48-A, 30 Sep 2026) art. 132 d.: 'de 1 080 001 Gourdes a 2 160 000 Gourdes: 25%' (start of the 25 % band). A statutory amount, not an average wage: 1 'AW' in scanner output = this amount of annual income.

registry_correction: Registry 'Decret sur l'impot sur le revenu; little accessible law' updated: a Code Fiscal (Décret of 19 December 2022) governed FY 2024-25 but was not reached; its replacement in force 1 October 2026 taxes global income 0/12/18/25/30 % (360,000 / 540,000 / 1,080,000 / 2,160,000) with a 1 % CAS levy on salaries; couples declare separately.
